Subject (in full) Meeting of local communists in Western District.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [签名]

Some 20 workers of Japanese cotton mills who are
members of the Western Distirct Branch of the Chinese Communist
Party held a meeting in an unnumbered house off Singapore Road,
O.O.L. between 8 and 9 p.m. May 31. One Wong Shih Ming (王華民), who
presided, reported on the failure of the plans made regarding
the May 30 Anniversary, and stated that the failure was due to
precautionary measures adopted by the Municipal Police which
resulted in the late arrival of the literature intended for
distribution. He then proposed that workers should hold
'flying' meetings simultaneously in all Japanese industrial
concerns by suspending work for one hour on June 1, the
anniversaries of the 1st Day of the General Strike of 1925
following the Nanking Road Incident, and the Massacre of Chinese
people by Japanese sailors in Changsha. This proposal was,
however, turned down on the ground that no adequate preparations
had been made.

It was then decided to hold a general meeting of
representatives on June 2 (venue of meeting not decided) to
discuss ways and means to commemorate the Anniversary of the
Shameen Incident on June 23.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
Commissioner of Police,
Sir,

Information. The proposal
to celebrate June 23 will be referred to
later in the Daily Intelligence Reports.
S2, Please see my remarks above.
Further report in due course.
[签名] 1/6/32

主题（全称） 西区当地共产党人会议。

由警探顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）制作。转呈 [签名]

约20名身为中国共产党西区支部成员的日本棉纱厂工人，于5月31日晚8时至9时之间，在越界筑路区新加坡路（Singapore Road）旁一处无门牌号的房屋内举行会议。主持会议的王华民（Wong Shih Ming）报告了关于“五卅”周年纪念活动计划的失败情况，并指出失败原因是由于工部局警务处采取了预防措施，导致拟分发的宣传品迟到。随后他提议，工人们应在6月1日停工一小时，同时在所有日本工业企业中举行“飞行集会”，以纪念南京路事件后1925年总罢工第一周年纪念日，以及中国人在长沙被日本水兵屠杀的事件。然而，该提议以准备不足为由被驳回。

随后决定于6月2日举行代表全体会议（会议地点未定），讨论纪念6月23日沙基惨案（Shameen Incident）周年的方法和手段。

顾宝华
警探

特务科主管警官。
致警务处处长，
阁下，

情报。关于庆祝6月23日的提议将在后续的《每日情报报告》中提及。
S2，请参阅我上面的备注。
届时将提交进一步报告。
[签名] 1/6/32

Subject (in full) Meeting of members of Western District Communist Party.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Agent reports some fifty members of the Western
District Communist Party held a meeting at No. 2543 Koong Ka
Jao (孔家橋), Jessfield Road O.O.L. between 5 p.m. and
7.30 p.m. August 20. The proceedings were presided over by
Poh Yoh Fang (卜毓芳), member of the Western District Committee.
It was decided that in view of the financial stringency
of the local communist fraternity, members be instructed to
become workers in the following industrial concerns in order
to provide for themselves and to foster communistic propaganda
among the workers :-

(魏老公) to organize the wharf transportation coolies in the
